what_happened: Crux probe for the frame-constructor prerequisite compiled clean on first serious attempt: ofSlicedStep_fib_finite's [Finite W] generalizes to two-sided finite branching on R in ~45 lines, carrier-agnostic, zero sorries, axiom profile [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]. Also machine-checked the dispatch's named hazard (reset-to-0-from-any-level gives an infinite d=-1 fibre) AND its symmetric twin (reset-from-0-to-any-level breaks the forward side instead).

Carried cost estimate challenged by measurement. Task 742 carried 1,200-2,000 lines HIGH plus a 300-500 line frame-constructor prerequisite. Research finds the prerequisite is NOT on the critical path for (S) at all: liveness is a HYPOTHESIS (Cons P) for soundness, not something the construction must engineer, so a finite-slice modelOf P built by the existing ofSlicedStep suffices. Revised estimate 600-900 lines, with the prerequisite reclassified as an optional, independently valuable 120-160 line parallel constructor.

eq_clTrace_of_localRun_anchored (Trace.lean) already performs the structural induction that the HWZ Theorem 14 (<=) direction needs, in the usable direction: LocalRun + Anchored implies c = clTrace. Both directions of Presented (modelOf P) reduce to it, so (S) needs no new formula induction provided phi is box-free and stab-free.

A real scope limitation found, not in the carried description: in any modelOf P whose labels satisfy the Cons untl/snce conditions, truth of every closure subformula is state-determined, so the constructed model satisfies stab psi <-> psi for every stab psi in the closure of phi. Nested stab is therefore realized only trivially. The honest (S) scope is box-free and stab-free phi, which the verdict's own table already assigns the box/stab anchors to requirement (W).

Plan-time re-resolution by name of all 22 substrate declarations the dispatch and research named found zero anchor drift, and the research dispatch's three compiled zero-sorry probes let Phase 2 be planned as a transcription rather than a proof: the untl half of Cons is already machine-checked, so the only genuinely new proof obligations are the snce mirror and presented_modelOf.

The carried 300-500 line regular-frame constructor prerequisite is descoped from this plan to a successor record, on the research dispatch's machine-checked finding that it is a completeness burden rather than a soundness one. Its hard part (fib_finite_of_finBranch) plus two refutations found during research are preserved by wiring the research probe as permanent evidence in Phase 1 instead of being carried as a blocking phase. file_scope is also set at plan time, as the dispatch required, closing the batch-admission overlap blindness the record was filed with.

Phase 1's Scope Hypothesis predicted '14 pre-existing registered probes becoming 15' and said any count other than 15 means the WIRED array was edited non-append-only. The gate script actually carries 21 WIRED plus 3 WIRED_REPO entries = 24 before, 25 after; the plan's figure was stale (it appears to count an older or partial array). Append-only editing was verified directly from the diff instead of from the count.

Phase 1 task text says to keep 'the #print axioms lines' from the source probe specs/746_.../evidence/01_fib-finite-generalization.lean, but that file has no #print axioms lines at all. An axiom foot covering all 18 declarations was written fresh in the house probe form, which is what the phase's own Verification criterion requires.

The research dispatch's probe compiled verbatim at its new evidence path on the first attempt, with every theorem on exactly [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] -- no citation drift to repair, so the phase cost was header prose plus registry wiring only.

Phase 2 was a true transcription: evidence/02_cons-untl-core.lean's four proofs carried over to FormalSystem/Metalogic/Decidability/RaySummary/Realize.lean with only binder-shape changes (section variables to explicit per-declaration binders, matching the plan's pinned Challenge signatures). No proof body needed re-derivation.

First scoped build of Realize.lean was green but emitted 9 style-linter warnings: unusedFintypeInType/unusedDecidableInType on four declarations (the plan's pinned Challenge variable block carries [Fintype sig.preds]/[DecidableEq sig.preds] across the whole namespace, so omitting them per-declaration would diverge from the pinned signature) and linter.style.show on the HasChain beta-reduction the research tactic survey explicitly requires. Resolved by commented, scoped set_option suppressions following FormalSystem/Metalogic/Decidability/RaySummary/Compose.lean's own precedent rather than by changing signatures or tactics; rebuild is warning-free. Later phases adding declarations under the same variable block will inherit the section-level suppression.

Plan Phase 3's parenthetical body for bwdDeferGraph reads 'lab y u && !(lab y e) && step x y', which is the FORWARD-oriented graph (live/HasChain in Present.lean always ask for forward chains G (f n) (f (n+1))). A backward deferral stretch runs the other way along step, so that body cannot be read off persistBwd directly -- its acyclicity is equivalent over a finite Q but only via a cycle-extraction argument. Implemented the house-convention reversal instead (fun x y => lab x u && !(lab x e) && step y x), mirroring Present.lean's bwdLive, which passes 'pathTypes ... y x' to live for exactly this reason. The same plan bullet instructs 'Record in the docstring which argument order of live is being used and why', so choosing and justifying the orientation was the assigned task; the parenthetical was treated as illustrative. Documented at length in bwdDeferGraph's docstring.

The entire Phase 3 snce section (SCoh, bwdDeferGraph, SLive, DischBwd, two decidability instances, persistBwd, disch_of_SCoh_SLive, u_of_dischBwd, snce_iff_of_SCoh_SLive) elaborated clean on the FIRST attempt in a standalone scratch file via 'lake env lean', zero errors and zero warnings, with all four theorems' axiom profile exactly [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]. Trialling the whole section standalone against the already-built Realize module, rather than editing the real file and iterating, cost one elaboration and avoided any churn on the module.

Phase 4's whole content elaborated clean on the FIRST scratch attempt via 'lake env lean' against the already-built Subformulas.olean: BoxStabFree, its hand-rolled Decidable instance, the inheritance lemma and both closure-vacuity lemmas, with both pinned lemmas already at exactly [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] and all five non-vacuity #eval checks correct. Only fix needed was the scratch #eval atoms (Atom is a structure with base/freshIndex, not a Nat), so the real module was edited exactly once. Same trial-before-edit discipline Phase 3 recorded.

Phase 4's Scope Hypothesis band (~60-95 lines added) was overshot: the diff is 117 insertions, 0 deletions. The binding half of the hypothesis holds exactly -- insertions only, zero existing declarations touched. The overshoot is entirely documentation: a 22-line section-header /-! block recording why SemanticBridge's isBoxFree is not reusable and why the predicate is Prop- rather than Bool-valued, plus per-declaration docstrings. Library code proper is ~85 lines, inside the band. No remedy taken; recorded so the plan's remaining phase estimates are read as code-line estimates that exclude docstring prose.

Phase 4's inheritance-lemma bullet instructed routing boxStabFree_of_mem_subformulas 'through the existing subformulas_trans / per-arm membership lemmas rather than re-deriving them'. Neither named helper is usable: subformulas_trans is a statement about membership and says nothing about BoxStabFree, and the eight per-arm lemmas CONSTRUCT a membership where this proof must DESTRUCTURE one (the opposite direction). Landed as an induction on phi mirroring subformulas_trans's own arm-for-arm shape, destructuring membership with simp only [subformulas, List.mem_cons, List.mem_append] exactly as that proof does -- so no project lemma is re-derived, which is what the hint protected. Statement and decomposition are exactly as pinned; phase NOT marked blocked because nothing is unproved and no alternative approach was substituted. Annotated inline in the plan.

Phase 5's Cons structure and cons_localRun elaborated clean on the first scratch attempt against the built Realize.olean (one trivial Bool.false_ne_true fix); cons_localRun is ~20 lines, well under the plan's 80-line re-derivation tripwire.

One three-state fixture serves BOTH the forward and the backward non-vacuity witness, and labConsBad (one letter changed) is simultaneously the ULive and the SLive negative control; hand-computed design confirmed by 15 passing #guards in a scratch file before either module was edited.

Phase 5's test-module task says 'append-only', but the fixtures reference UCoh/ULive/SCoh/SLive/bwdDeferGraph, which the RaySummary aggregator does not yet re-export (Phase 8 owns that edge). Added a direct 'import FormalSystem.Metalogic.Decidability.RaySummary.Realize' line to the test module -- additive, but not strictly an append. The alternative (re-spelling the definitions inline, as evidence probe 03 does) would have made the guards check copies rather than the landed declarations.

The once-only now condition is checked in the test module by a depth-3 enumeration (the plan's own spelling, 'checked to the carrier's full depth'), which is NOT a witness of the StepPath-quantified Cons.nowOnce field itself. Recorded honestly in the test module prose rather than overclaimed; a proved instance would need ~20 lines of List/StepPath reasoning the plan did not ask for.

Phase 6's whole section elaborated clean on the first scratchpad attempt: frameOf, the IsRegular instance, frameOf_not_finite_worldState, modelOf, modelOf_valuation, frameOf_step and frameOf_mem_HF_iff are all one-line citations of ofSlicedStep's landed companions, and the (frameOf hC).WorldState projections (w.2, (z,q)) unified with the ofSlicedStep carrier definitionally with no show/change needed.

The plan's Lean Challenge Statements variable block carries only {Q : Type} [Fintype Q] [DecidableEq Q], but FrameOver carries a worldNonempty field and ofSlicedStep requires [Nonempty W], so the new section's variable block adds [Nonempty Q]. The Phase 6 task body explicitly instructs 'taking [Fintype Q] (hence [Finite Q]) and [Nonempty Q] from the presentation', so the phase body authorizes it and the Challenge block is simply incomplete relative to it; without [Nonempty Q] the pinned frameOf is not inhabitable at all. Annotated inline in the plan and named in the handoff rather than raised as a blocker.

The first git-commit-scoped.sh invocation was refused by the typst-sync-check.sh Check 2 pre-commit gate: formalsystem-line-count committed=348241 live=348354, because this phase's +113 lines in Realize.lean drift the generated status counts. Resolved exactly as Phases 2-5 did (git log on typst/generated/status.typ shows all four in its history): ran 'bash scripts/typst-sync-check.sh --fix' and added typst/generated/status.typ to the phase commit's explicit path list. Note --counts-only is not composable with --fix (the script rejects the pair). The script's co-reported 670-vs-671 import-line note is a WARNING, not the VIOLATION, and is the pre-existing consequence of Realize.lean not yet being in FormalSystem.lean -- Phase 8 owns that aggregator edge.

Phase 7 (<=) direction unprovable from Phase 5's ten Cons fields: the plan's own StabFibre step needs rho t = q0, IsRun only gives lab (rho t) (clNow phi) = true, and no Cons field makes the clNow state unique. Counterexample (prose, not machine-checked): two mutually unreachable now-components with different atom labels satisfy all ten fields. Resolution: one new field Cons.nowUnique; Cons's Challenge pin is field-free so no pinned signature drifts.

Once Cons.nowUnique was in place, the whole of Phase 7 (three helpers plus the two pinned theorems, ~130 lines of code) elaborated green in the scratchpad with only two diagnostics across two passes: an unknown constant Bool.true_ne_false (replaced by simp at this) and one linter.style.show warning on the probe-copied splice block (suppressed declaration-scoped, following the module's own two precedents). The real module was edited once. Both Presented directions went green in the same pass, so the plan's separate (<=)/(=>) commits had no intermediate green state to attach to. The Phase 6 handoff's two shape notes -- that frameOf_mem_HF_iff's (=>) direction yields SOME k which must be pinned from the seam anchor, and that Cons.nowOnce is StepPath-quantified and needs a path built -- were both exactly right and saved the two likeliest dead ends.
